requirements.text: Decode declared schema versions and preserve event identity and event time.
Compute half-open tumbling sums/counts and quarantine excessively late events.
Bound memory, spill deterministically and commit progress with state/output.

problem.scope: Finite events carry explicit event timestamps and schema-version transitions. Compare incremental keyed event-time state with immutable microbatch recomputation. Watermarks express a lateness policy: as in the cited Spark guide, a late event still updates its window until the watermark passes that window's end. Bounded memory/spill and replay are explicit.

evidence.testName: L030 incremental windows follow window-end lateness and evict finalized state

acceptanceCases.given: 10ms windows with 5ms allowed lateness receive times 9, 10, a duplicate 9, an out-of-order 4, an unknown schema, then 25, a straggler at 7 and a redelivered 10.
acceptanceCases.then: Time 4 still counts in the open [0,10) window; at watermark 20 windows [0,10) and [10,20) are emitted and their sums and event IDs evicted, so the straggler and the redelivery are quarantined rather than recounted; the duplicate is ignored and the unknown schema quarantined.
acceptanceCases.when: Fold them through the incremental window state.

acceptanceCases.given: An event lands exactly at a tumbling-window boundary.
acceptanceCases.then: Assign the event to the new half-open window, independent of arrival order.
acceptanceCases.when: Decode its version and compute floor(eventTime/width).

evidence.testName: L030 incremental windows follow window-end lateness and evict finalized state

acceptanceCases.given: Windows are 10ms, allowed lateness is 5ms and the max event time seen is 17, so the watermark is 12.
acceptanceCases.then: Time 4 is quarantined because window [0,10) closed at watermark 12; time 11 still updates the open [10,20) window although it is below the watermark.

acceptanceCases.given: A worker crashes after output is written but before source checkpoint commit.
acceptanceCases.then: Deduplicate or reconcile versioned output so sum/count do not double; unknown schema versions remain quarantined.
acceptanceCases.when: Restore and replay the same event identities.

acceptanceCases.given: A partition's FIFO reaches its byte budget while window state is spilling.
acceptanceCases.then: Admission pauses for that partition; queued events keep offset order and none is dropped or reordered.
acceptanceCases.when: The source offers more events for that partition.

acceptanceCases.given: Batch b1 holds time 9 (delivered twice) and time 10; b2 redelivers the time-9 event under a new offset with an out-of-order time 4 and an unknown schema at frozen watermark 5; b3 has watermark 20 and a straggler at time 4.
acceptanceCases.then: The redelivered event adds nothing to [0,10) and time 4 counts because that window is still open; replaying b2 is already-committed; in b3 the straggler is quarantined and closed windows keep their sums but drop their event-ID index.
acceptanceCases.when: Commit b1 and b2, replay b2, then commit b3.

acceptanceCases.given: New arrivals appear while a batch runs.
acceptanceCases.then: The new arrivals enter a later batch; an event is quarantined only when its window end is at or below that batch's frozen watermark.
acceptanceCases.when: Finish the frozen upper offsets and watermark.
